entries.title: ADR-0001: Workflow-driven, not prompt-driven
entries.summary: - Status: accepted - Date: 2026-08-07

entries.title: ADR-0002: Never assume backend access
entries.summary: See body.

entries.title: Anti-pattern: Inventing backend contracts
entries.summary: See body.

entries.title: Anti-pattern: Parallel design systems
entries.summary: Do not introduce new UI kits, color systems, or typography scales when the repository already has tokens/components.

entries.title: Anti-pattern: Prompt-only process
entries.summary: Do not replace Engineering OS workflows with ad-hoc prompt chains. Start a workflow and follow `eos next`.

entries.title: Anti-pattern: Skipping gates
entries.summary: Agents must not implement past pending `contract-approval`, `architecture-approval`, or `delivery-signoff` requirements.

entries.title: Invented API fields break clients
entries.summary: Assuming response fields that the backend does not provide causes runtime UI failures.

entries.title: Impact then reuse
entries.summary: Generate feature impact first, then ranked reuse analysis, before writing an implementation plan.

entries.title: Refresh Project DNA before planning
entries.summary: Stale inventories cause false reuse misses; refresh DNA before plan phase.

entries.title: Pattern: Capability-gated verification
entries.summary: Only require lint/test/e2e/CI steps that the Repository Profile shows as present. Document skips with evidence.

entries.title: Pattern: Contract-first delivery
entries.summary: Do not implement feature work until a Feature Contract exists and `contract-approval` is approved (for workflows that require it).

entries.title: Pattern: Evidence-based discovery
entries.summary: Always cite file paths, manifests, or command output when describing how a repository works. Mark unknowns as `unknown` instead of guessing.

entries.title: Pattern: Reuse map before code
entries.summary: See body.

entries.title: Playbook: Architecture change
entries.summary: 1. Mark Implementation Plan `architectural impact: yes`. 2. Run `eos set-flag architectural_impact true`.

entries.title: Playbook: Missing tests capability
entries.summary: 1. Record `unit-tests` / `e2e-tests` as absent in Repository Profile. 2. In Verification Plan, skip automated tests with evidence.

entries.title: Playbook: No backend access
entries.summary: See body.

entries.title: Archetype: Backend
entries.summary: - Module boundaries, auth guards, validation, data access - Migrations and API contracts

entries.title: Archetype: Frontend
entries.summary: - UI component libraries and design tokens - Routing and state management patterns

entries.title: Archetype: Fullstack
entries.summary: - End-to-end contract ownership between client and server - Shared types/packages if present

entries.title: Archetype: Monorepo
entries.summary: - Workspace tooling (pnpm/nx/turbo) - Package boundaries and dependency direction
